safe.en: Make sure your bag is in a safe place when travelling.
safe.cn: 旅行时确保包放在安全的地方。

danger.en: Swimming in deep water alone is very dangerous.
danger.cn: 独自在深水中游泳非常危险。

warning.en: The warning sign says "No swimming" by this part of the lake.
warning.cn: 湖这一段的警示牌写着"禁止游泳"。

rule.en: We should follow the rules of every place we visit.
rule.cn: 我们应当遵守每个游览地点的规则。

follow.en: Always follow the safety rules on a school trip.
follow.cn: 学校旅行一定要遵守安全规则。

careful.en: Be very careful when you cross a busy road.
careful.cn: 过繁忙的马路时要非常小心。

phone.en: Bring a phone in case of emergencies.
phone.cn: 带上手机以备紧急情况。

remember.en: Remember Mum's phone number by heart, just in case.
remember.cn: 把妈妈的电话号码背下来，以防万一。
